source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check Mini DP ouput
1. Connect Screen via rear Mini DP port.
2. Check Mini DP signal can output from rear Mini DP port.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- MiniDP output (Display / resolution / Ripple-less): MiniDP output (display/resolution/ripple-less) verification requires observing a physical display connected to the MiniDP port (resolution, no rippling); human visual check.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator confirms the MiniDP display/resolution + the absence of ripple; agent cannot see the display.

original_test_intent: Verify the rear MiniDP connector produces a visible signal at the approved resolution/refresh and that the physical screen is free of ripple, artifacts and display errors.
original_method: An engineer connects the approved screen and cable to the identified rear MiniDP port, observes the full image over the defined interval and records resolution plus visual quality while supporting device/log state is captured.
manual_activity: Physical cable connection and direct observation of signal, resolution, ripple, flicker, artifacts and full-screen errors are the core acceptance activities.
required_inputs: Expected resolution, refresh, colour and ripple/artifact criteria
Observation duration/content, maintenance window and alternate console
safety_requirements: Do not force the connector or use an unapproved cable/adapter.
Assess whether connecting the screen changes an active console or user session.
Do not change driver or resolution beyond the approved visual plan.
Stop on no signal, ripple/artifacts, connector damage, driver error or loss of recovery; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only output mapping, EDID, active mode, driver and log state before/after connection.
Prepare a fixed visual pattern/observation checklist and organize operator photos/video.
Correlate electronic state without claiming direct visual observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the port/cable/monitor/mode and visual thresholds.
Connect the display and observe the physical image for the required quality and interval.
Issue PASS/FAIL after reviewing all evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct: no remote command can prove a visible ripple-free image. Software display enumeration is supporting evidence only.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use OS-native read-only EDID/output/mode and driver health data only to correlate the operator's observation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Rear MiniDP connection, output/display/no-error and ripple-less intent, plus 20/20-minute fields, are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map the rear connector, connect the approved display chain, show a fixed full-screen diagnostic pattern at the specified mode, record timestamped photo/video over the required interval and correlate with EDID/link/driver logs.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact rear MiniDP output, cable/adapter, GPU driver and monitor.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board/GPU firmware, driver and EDID revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner display/output specification and monitor/cable capability data.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a defined pattern, interval and electronic correlation without replacing human visual acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; enumeration alone is not accepted as visible/ripple-less coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Still photos may miss temporal ripple/flicker; use video or sustained observation where required.

project_override_considerations: The project supplies the mode, monitor chain and observation interval. Missing project values affect readiness, not permanent BLOCKED. A headless/EDID-only substitute would reduce the explicit visual coverage.
expected_evidence: Rear port/GPU/cable/monitor/EDID and approved mode identities
Timestamped full-screen photo/video or operator observation showing signal and no ripple/error
Supporting mode/link/driver state and unexpected-log review
Restored console/display state and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, procedure and criterion consistently require visible rear MiniDP output without display error; ripple-less is an additional title-level quality attribute retained by semantic overlay.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical method is clear. Exact display-chain and visual thresholds are execution-readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with human-only classification and retain resolution/ripple observation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and retain its port identity, alternate-console and visual-evidence controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes title-level ripple coverage explicit and distinguishes photos from temporal video/observation.

review_improvement: Prevents EDID/link detection or a single image from being overstated as proof of a stable ripple-free physical display.
independent_technical_reasoning: Signal presence, ripple and artifacts are physical visual properties. Electronic link/mode data cannot establish them, so the case is MANUAL ONLY with agent evidence support.
